headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins secured a crucial 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, while the St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 7-1. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Athletics 8-4, and the Colorado Rockies edged out the Arizona Diamondbacks 6-4. Meanwhile, the Toronto Blue Jays placed right-handed pitcher Jake Bloss on the 60-day injured list.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with the Toronto Blue Jays' Jake Bloss joining the list due to a 60-day injured list stint. Other notable injuries include Riley Greene (Detroit Tigers) with a right hamstring strain, Kyle Karros (Colorado Rockies) with a concussion, and José Suarez (Athletics) with a right hip strain.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including Harold Rivas joining the Baltimore Orioles in a trade involving the Boston Red Sox. Other notable transactions include the Miami Marlins trading Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins outlasted the Baltimore Orioles 7-5, securing a crucial win in their matchup. Dylan Beavers led the Orioles' offense with a home run and three RBIs, while Yaramil Hiraldo impressed on the mound with 1.2 scoreless innings.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, winning 7-1 behind a strong performance from Kyle Leahy, who pitched 5.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 1 earned run. Alec Burleson led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Athletics 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Hicks finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Ryan Feltner earning the win. Brett Sullivan led the Rockies' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays RHP Bloss Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right-handed pitcher Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list, marking a significant update to the team's roster.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
